title: 💹 A historic day on Wall Street!
body: 💹 A historic day on Wall Street!
Anthropic shares began trading today on the Nasdaq under the ticker ANT, at eighty-three dollars a share, in an offering that raised more than eighty-one billion dollars.
The company offered around nine hundred and eighty million shares, and at the same time raised twenty-six billion dollars from major investors, including Google, Nvidia and Microsoft.
Simply put, the AI company behind the Claude assistant is now a public company, and any investor can buy its shares.
Do you believe in the future of AI companies on the stock market? And why?
